run_inferrer_cli: run the LRM inferrer CLI to generate 3D meshes and turn videos from source images
create_LRMInferrer: create an LRMInferrer instance with a model name and checkpoint path for 3D reconstruction
infer_single_image: infer a single image to produce 3D mesh and turn video renderings using the LRM model
infer_batch_images: infer a batch of images from a source directory to export 3D meshes and turn videos
build_render_cameras: build surrounding camera views for turntable video rendering from spherical coordinates
